measurements.name: cuda_fp32_gflops
measurements.method: 8 independent FFMA chains x 4096 iterations at full occupancy; 2 flops per FFMA

measurements.name: cuda_int32_gops
measurements.method: 8 independent IMAD chains x 4096 iterations at full occupancy

measurements.name: sfu_exp2_gops
measurements.method: inline ex2.approx.f32, 8 chains x 4096 iterations

measurements.name: sfu_rsqrt_gops
measurements.method: inline rsqrt.approx.f32, 8 chains x 4096 iterations

measurements.name: tc_fp16_gflops
measurements.method: 4 independent mma.sync.m16n8k16.f32.f16.f16.f32 chains x 4096 iterations; 4096 flops per instruction

measurements.name: smem_gbps
measurements.method: conflict-free ld.shared, 8 loads per iteration x 4096 iterations

measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w2
measurements.method: elapsed of the same loop with a `ways`-way bank conflict, relative to the conflict-free loop

measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w4
measurements.method: elapsed of the same loop with a `ways`-way bank conflict, relative to the conflict-free loop

measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w8
measurements.method: elapsed of the same loop with a `ways`-way bank conflict, relative to the conflict-free loop

measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w16
measurements.method: elapsed of the same loop with a `ways`-way bank conflict, relative to the conflict-free loop

measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w32
measurements.method: elapsed of the same loop with a `ways`-way bank conflict, relative to the conflict-free loop

measurements.name: smem_conflict_slope
measurements.method: least squares through the origin of t(w)/t(1) against w over the ways whose ratio exceeds 1.05; the cost model applies max(1, slope * ways)

measurements.name: l2_gbps
measurements.method: ld.global.cg streaming read, plateau (maximum) of the working-set sweep

measurements.name: dram_gbps
measurements.method: same sweep, median of the 512-2048 MiB working sets (achieved, not peak)

measurements.name: l2_knee_bytes
measurements.method: largest working set of the sweep still within 95% of the plateau bandwidth

measurements.name: atomic_uncontended_ns
measurements.method: one CTA, dependent chain of 2048 global atomicAdd; the return value feeds the next address so this is latency, not issue rate

measurements.name: atomic_contention_ns
measurements.method: N CTAs hammering one address; the recorded value is inverse throughput (elapsed / N / iters), which is what T_sync = |image(C_kappa)| * latency multiplies

measurements.name: threadfence_ns
measurements.method: store + __threadfence loop at full occupancy, minus the same loop without the fence

measurements.name: syncthreads_ns
measurements.method: store + __syncthreads loop at full occupancy, minus the same loop without the barrier; 256 threads per CTA

measurements.name: named_barrier_ns
measurements.method: store + bar.sync 1 loop at full occupancy, minus the same loop without the barrier; 256 threads per CTA

measurements.name: streamk_combine_d_ns
measurements.method: GemmCombine duration against (peers-1)*elements over widths {1024,4096,16384,65536,262144} x chunks {2,4,8,16,32}, launch subtracted; every point L2-resident, as the reference models are

measurements.name: streamk_combine_d_dram_ns
measurements.method: the same slope at a 128 MB working set, past the L2 knee: the regime the reference models do not reach, recorded so the two are not averaged

measurements.name: streamk_combine_base_ns
measurements.method: slope of the chunks=1 reduction against width: the output store and the single partial read, measured rather than extrapolated

measurements.name: streamk_combine_fixed_ns
measurements.method: intercept of the same chunks=1 fit; unresolved -- |value| < 300 ns with a 150% spread over five runs and either sign, so the profile carries max(0, fit)

measurements.name: streamk_combine_peer_r2
measurements.method: fit quality of d across widths

measurements.name: streamk_combine_width_r2
measurements.method: fit quality of the peer-independent part across widths

measurements.name: streamk_a_ns[128x128x16s3]
measurements.method: intercept of per-CTA time vs MAC iterations over {1,2,4,8,16,32,64}, unsplit single-wave GEMM at M=4, N=768, launch time subtracted; r2=0.999984

measurements.name: streamk_c_ns[128x128x16s3]

measurements.name: interference_neighbour_gbps
measurements.method: read-modify-write over 256 MiB at one CTA per SM, four passes; the neighbour interference_ratio is measured against

measurements.name: interference_ratio
measurements.method: median of paired ratios; each pair is the duration of a 16x64x32s3 GEMM (M=4, N=1536, K=2048, split 16) on its own stream while a 256 MiB streaming read-modify-write runs at one CTA per SM on another stream, over the same GEMM measured immediately before

measurements.name: dram_peak_gbps
measurements.method: 2 * memory clock * bus width from cudaDeviceGetAttribute; the pin rate, not an achieved one

measurements.name: dram_fraction_of_peak
measurements.method: achieved dram_gbps over the pin rate; the run is rejected below kMinFractionOfPeak

measurements.name: dram_drift
measurements.method: largest working set re-measured after every other group, against its value from the sweep; the run is rejected above kMaxDrift
